description: This file defines a controller class for managing IP-based fraud detection features in an OpenCart admin module. It includes methods for displaying, adding, removing, installing, and uninstalling IP addresses related to fraud prevention, along with handling configurations and permissions.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: Controller class for managing IP addresses related to fraud detection, including CRUD operations and configuration management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main view for managing fraud IP settings, including breadcrumbs, status, and list of IPs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of IP fraud configuration settings after permission check.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the IP fraud extension if the user has modify permissions.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls the IP fraud extension if the user has modify permissions.

methods.name: ip
methods.description: Displays the list of IP addresses associated with fraud detection.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Returns a paginated view of IP addresses with associated customer count and links.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Adds a new IP address to the fraud list after validation and permission check.

methods.name: removeIp
methods.description: Removes an IP address from the fraud list after permission validation.
